theme: Foreign-find site census and corpus provenance
question: Which published Indus-related objects occur at the requested foreign sites, and what evidence and local coverage can be established?
outcome: 36 rows cover 23 named sites, all 27 local regional labels and Babylon. Local totals are 42 faces and 42 object-family labels. Fourteen final-report bibliographies and nine coordinate witnesses were identified. Selected mixed-class object minima sum to 36 across 22 rows; complete coverage fractions remain undefined. Four later inscription-related reports were recorded, with zero matched post-CISI cutoffs. The build and independent reference/CSV/hash checks pass.
challenge: Mixed glyptic and other-script catalogue sequences, uncertain signs, production/findspot labels, blocked downloads and incomplete object joins prevent a complete site inventory. Several geography, campaign, custody and main-publication metadata fields remain unresolved after searches.
remedy: Preserved local figures and counting units; added CISI 3.3 (2022) through a dated protocol amendment; recovered original Nippur and Tell Asmar reports through current ISAC S3 routes; retained every query, snippet and failed acquisition locally; provided source-linked rows and deterministic checks.
retry_when: Actual CISI plates, Kjaerum's catalogue, inaccessible final reports, Mahadevan/ICIT site subtotals or specimen photographs become available for reviewed object joins; dedicated geographic authorities can resolve remaining locations.
